csvHelp.title: What your class list must look like
csvHelp.subtitle: A CSV is nothing more than a simple table. You can create it in Excel, LibreOffice, Numbers or Google Sheets and save it as CSV there.
csvHelp.tableCaption: Example of a class list. The first row holds the column headers, after that each row is one student.

rules.headerRow: Row 1 holds the column headers. Only the “Name” column is required.
rules.oneRow: From row 2 on each row is one student.
rules.optional: Every other column is optional, for example Restless, Window seat or Wish partner. Columns Klassenplan does not know are simply ignored.
rules.saveAs: When saving, pick “CSV” as the file type. In Excel that is “File > Save as”.
